name: Your June 15
source:
Today is June 15. Follow the lives of five people on this day, and encounter a mysterious figure. Who is he? What is he doing? Make choices along the way and see where they lead.

[From [url=https://pinkberry74.itch.io/your-june-15]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是6月15日，跟随五人这一天的生活，邂逅神秘人物。他是谁？他在做什么？一路上做出选择，看看它们会走向何方。

[来自[url=https://pinkberry74.itch.io/your-june-15]Itch.io[/url]]
